title: Roasted Red Pepper Hummus with Toasted Almonds
summary: Chickpeas are processed with rinsed roasted peppers, garlic, salt, cayenne and paprika, loosened with lemon juice and water, and blended creamy with tahini and oil; finished with toasted almonds and parsley.

ingredients.item: 400 g can chickpeas, drained and rinsed
jarred roasted red peppers, rinsed and patted very dry
fine sea salt or table salt
pita breads, warmed and cut into wedges

steps.title: Mix the tahini
steps.text: Whisk the tahini with the oil.

steps.title: Toast the almonds
steps.text: Toast in a dry pan until golden.

steps.title: Grind
steps.text: Process the chickpeas, peppers, garlic and spices 15 seconds.

steps.title: Loosen
steps.text: Stream in the lemon juice and water and process 1 minute.

steps.title: Cream
steps.text: Add the tahini mixture and process until smooth.

steps.title: Rest and serve
steps.text: Rest 30 minutes, then top with almonds, parsley and oil.

tips: Dry the peppers well or the hummus turns runny.
Rinsing the peppers removes some of the brine and salt.
Add cumin for an earthier version.
storage: Refrigerate covered for up to 4 days. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
